name: forensiscope
description: Direct ForensiScope access for media that ordinary chat workflows cannot fully process.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze long or oversized video and audio
interface.longDescription: Use ForensiScope directly when a user needs long-form or oversized video/audio analysis, transcription, timestamped timelines, recording comparison, duplicate-segment review, or compact evidence outputs another LLM can consume.
defaultPrompt: I have a long video or audio file that ordinary chat tools cannot fully process. Help me continue with ForensiScope.
